items.markdown:
Matrixyl Synthe'6 (palmitoyl tripeptide-38) is a signaling peptide that rebuilds skin from the inside out by stimulating **six skin-rebuilding essentials** : Collagen I, Collagen III, Collagen IV, Fibronectin, Hyaluronic Acid, and Laminin-5.[[1]](https://www.stonevillenc.org/matrixyl-synthe-6-complex-35-peptide-face-serum-focus/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AYBa2s41O68&t=92)[[3]](https://inspira-cosmetics-distribution.ie/2020/04/30/what-is-matrixyl-synthe-6/)

### Key Benefits

- **Reduces Deep Wrinkles & Expression Lines:** Targets stubborn areas like forehead wrinkles and crow's feet by smoothing skin from within.[[1]](https://sentisenti.com/products/timeless-matrixyl-synthe6-serum)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AYBa2s41O68&t=92)
- **Boosts Structural Proteins:** Increases key collagen types and fibronectin to restore firmness and diminish skin sagging.[[1]](https://inspira-cosmetics-distribution.ie/2020/04/30/what-is-matrixyl-synthe-6/)[[2]](https://skindeva.com/matrixyl-for-skin/)
- **Deeply Plumps & Hydrates:** Stimulates natural hyaluronic acid production to improve moisture retention and bounce.[[1]](https://inspira-cosmetics-distribution.ie/2020/04/30/what-is-matrixyl-synthe-6/)[[2]](https://www.lemon8-app.com/@restreligion/7472438800761782826?region=us)
- **Refines Skin Texture:** Supports laminin-5 and matrix integrity to create a smoother, more even surface.[[1]](https://inspira-cosmetics-distribution.ie/2020/04/30/what-is-matrixyl-synthe-6/)[[2]](https://sentisenti.com/products/timeless-matrixyl-synthe6-serum)
- **Gentle & Compatible:** Non-irritating and suitable for sensitive skin; it layers safely with active ingredients like hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and vitamin C.[[1]](https://www.trulybeauty.com/blogs/skincare/matrixyl-peptide)[[2]](https://www.stonevillenc.org/matrixyl-synthe-6-complex-35-peptide-face-serum-focus/)

If you'd like, let me know:

- **Your primary skin goal** (e.g., deep wrinkles vs. general firmness)
- **What other products** are currently in your routine

I can help you figure out how to layer it safely.
